column1: Store name as per Uber Eats manager
column2: External store ID as per Uber Eats manager
column4: Order ID as per Uber Eats manager
column5: Unique ID to identify the order
column6: Local date the order was placed, or local date of the original order placed for which there is a refund
column7: Local timestamp for when order was accepted by the merchant
column9: The mode of order fulfillment whether it was delivery by courier via Uber network, delivery by merchant, Pick-up by customer or Dine-in
column10: The platform from which the customer ordered, (i.e. iOS, Android, Uber Eats Web)
column11: Either: Completed (eater received food), Cancelled (order cancelled by eater or support), Refund (eater was refunded for order), or Unfulfilled (order was not able to be completed)
column12: Uber membership status of the customer who placed the order
column15: Tax on total item sales in the order
column16: Amount merchants are responsible for refunding customers when they report order errors (excl VAT)
column17: VAT refunded to customers on order refunds
column18: Amount merchants are responsible for refunding customers when they report order errors (incl VAT)
column19: Adjustments merchants made to the price of items once an order has been placed (excl tax)
column21: Merchant promotions applied to the order
column24: Amount merchant charges Uber for co-funded marketing campaigns. Varies depending on co-funding % for the campaign.
column25: Payout from the third party meal voucher company e.g., Edenred, Swile etc.
column26: Name of the third party meal voucher company e.g., Edenred, Swile etc.
column27: Total item sales including promotions and adjustments incl tax where applicable
column28: Merchant promotions applied to the delivery fee charged to Eaters
column29: The fee Uber charges to merchant to make their store visible to potential customers, provide support and other related services ( %fee is applied to sub-total before discounts)
column30: Total Tax on Uber Service Fee charged to merchant
column31: VAT withholdings only apply  in Mexico, to merchants registered as individuals. Uber withholds half of the VAT collected and pays it to the government on behalf of the merchant.
column32: IT withholdings only apply  in Mexico, to merchants registered as individuals. Uber withholds 1% of the basket collected and pays it to the government on behalf of the merchant.
column33: Fee charged for Uber delivery service (only applicable to merchants who do self-delivery but avail Uber delivery service)
column34: For merchants who perform their own delivery, the tip from the Eater to the courier
column35: Description of adhoc one-time payments or charges from Uber to the merchant
column36: All miscellaneous payments like Ad payments, Ad credits etc. inclusive of tax
column37: Total amount collected by Uber when the order happens in cash, Merchant will receive the 100% of the total amount.
column38: The net item value used as the base for calculating income tax (ISR) withholdings. This value is calculated as the Gross Item Price minus all applicable taxes (IVA and IEPS)
column39: The specific amount of the Special Tax on Production and Services (IEPS) applied to the item, based on its product category as per Mexican tax regulations.
column41: Total payout associated with this order (negative if associated with a refund). Sales + Adjustments - promotions + marketing adjustment + delivery fee (self delivery) + tips (self-delivery) - marketplace fee +/- other payments inclusive of taxes where applicable + Meal Voucher amount
column42: Date payout initiated by Uber (generally the Monday following the prior week)
column43: Link to the 'Uber to Restaurant' invoice .pdf
column44: This is the ID from retailers, used to identify retailer loyalty customers
column45: The reference ID for identifying the payout related to this order in the Payout Summary Report CSV
